change.noPrevious: Nothing recorded before this period to compare with
change.notEnough: Not enough days with numbers to compare
change.oneReading: Only one reading so far: no change to show yet
change.same_one: About the same as the previous day
change.same_other: About the same as the previous {{count}} days
compare.caption_one: Ratings and stability by platform, against the previous day
compare.caption_other: Ratings and stability by platform, against the previous {{count}} days
count.lowSample: Low sample: read this with care
count.notGiven: This store does not give the number of ratings.
countries.caption: Ratings by country for {{platform}}
countries.note: Kiln reads a few countries per sync, so this is not every country. An average over a small count can swing a lot.
empty.android: Google Play gives the average rating in its reports, but no count and no stars. Turn on the Google Play reports in Overview, Data sources, then Sync.
empty.error: Could not read the {{platform}} ratings. Try Sync again.
empty.ios: Apple does not provide rating history. Kiln records one point each time it syncs, so the trend starts with the first sync: run Sync (top right) to begin.
note.countDropped: The number of ratings fell between two readings: stores can remove ratings. That is not counted as new ratings.
note.gap: Some days have no reading (no sync): a change between two readings is counted on the later day.
note.newUnknown: New ratings need two readings: they appear after the next sync.
note.noCount: This store gives neither the number of ratings nor their stars.
note.reset: The store reset the summary rating in this period: the count starts again from that day.
rail.label: Sections of ratings and health
releases.caption: Releases of {{platform}}
releases.lead: How stability and the rating moved around each release. A before and after comparison, never proof of cause: other things change at the same time.
releases.legend: Crash rate: the previous version, then this one. Rating: the 14 days before the release, then 7 to 14 days after it.
releases.tooEarlyTitle: Too early: the release is under 7 days old
reviews.empty: No written reviews in this period for {{platform}}. Sync reviews to read new ones.
reviews.lead: The written reviews Kiln stored in this period. Low means {{max}} stars or fewer. These are reviews with text, not every rating.
since.android: Google Play gives no rating history through its API: this trend comes from its daily reports, as recorded since {{date}}.
since.ios: Apple gives no rating history: Kiln records one point per sync, from {{date}}. Earlier days are not available.
since.oneReading: Only one reading so far, so there is no trend yet. A point is added at each sync.
stability.coverage_one: Only {{days}} of the last day has numbers.
stability.coverage_other: Only {{days}} of the last {{count}} days have numbers.
stability.error: The last read of the {{platform}} crash numbers failed. Open data sources for the reason, then Sync.
stability.noneAndroid: No crash or ANR numbers for {{platform}} yet. They come from Android vitals (the Play Developer Reporting API): turn them on in data sources, then Sync.
stability.noneIos: No crash numbers for {{platform}} yet. Apple sends them with App Analytics, for people who opted in, and only for days with at least five crashing users. Turn on analytics, then Sync.
stability.noteAndroid: Google Play reports the share of users with a crash or an ANR, for users who opted in.
stability.noteIos: Apple counts only people who shared analytics, and sends crash numbers only for days with at least five crashing users: a day without a number is not a day without crashes.
stability.setup: Crash numbers for {{platform}} are not set up yet: the store source behind them is off or needs a permission.
tile.averageTitle: The rating the store shows now, from the latest reading Kiln made
tile.countTitle: How many people rated the app, from the latest reading
tile.lowTitle: Written reviews with {{max}} stars or fewer
tile.newTitle: Ratings added in this period: the difference between two readings of the store
tile.rateTitle: Mean of the {{days}} days with numbers in this period
tile.reviewsTitle: Reviews with text that Kiln stored in this period (not the same as ratings)
